newsitem.title: USA: New Citibank unit focuses on growth.
newsitem.headline: New Citibank unit focuses on growth.

text.p: Citibank's new global markets unit within its corporate bank is primarily focused on growth, a spokeswoman said Thursday in response to a question.

"This is very much going after new revenue," said Amy Dates, a spokeswoman. She said the company would follow chairman John Reed's corporate goal of having every dollar of new costs matched by two dollars of incremental revenue.

She said the new unit would "reduce costs in the sense that we are merging units" and eliminating overlapping processes and duplicaton, but she said the savings would be invested back into the business.
The new unit will be headed by Ernst Brutsche in partnership with Alan MacDonald, Dipak Rastogi and Julian Simmonds. The global markets union will report to Robert McCormack and Dennis Martin.
Citibank is the global banking business of Citicorp.
